justification: Although the case includes Article 11 assembly complaints for most applicants, the Article 11 merits analysis is not a single coherent unified reasoning but rather a bare cross-reference to well-established case-law applied individually to each applicant via the appended table, and two applicants (nos. 1 and 2) have no Article 11 complaint at all, meaning there is no single coherent merits analysis applicable across all applicants.
